new_principles.interpretation: Empathy-driven engineering. The agent must think from Michael's perspective, not from protocol compliance. Value delivery over process completion.
After every run, ask: if Notion AI agents disappeared right now, what permanent artifact did this run create? 'Updated Notion state' = FAIL.
The repo is not a backup copy. It IS the permanent record. Notion is the workbench. GitHub is where value survives.

system_design_insights: Unified engine model: Pulse and reincarnation are warm and deep layers of the same intelligence loop. Hourly = warm (LRS). Session = deep (12-section). Bridge connects with <1 hour latency.
Three artifact classes (VAULT/BUILD/SEED) give every run a clear output category.
Export Pipeline (UNMIRRORED→MIRRORED→SYNCED→ENRICHED) creates a progression metric toward platform-death-proof.
Cross-repo mining is the v5 multiplier — synthesis across 3 repos > any single source.
Self-bootstrapping repo: every SEED artifact makes rebuild from GitHub alone possible.
